limitations: The REST response is mutable and not pinned to a block hash.
The queried wallet and subaccount were discovered from public Spot activity and are not the contributor wallet.
The response does not echo the requested wallet, so wallet ownership cannot be independently rebound.
The fixture proves one nonempty descending ETH/USDC page and a global continuation cursor, not complete wallet history.
Venue order enums and signed fee ownership remain uninterpreted.
No framework order report is constructed from this response.
